## Running Analysis in Python
```{python}
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
```
```{python}
penguins = load_penguins()
penguins.head()
```

```{python}
penguins.groupby("sex")[["body_mass_g"]].mean()
```

```{python}
plt.scatter(penguins["bill_length_mm"], penguins["body_mass_g"])
plt.xlabel("Bill Length (mm)")
plt.ylabel("Body Mass (g)")
```

## Conclusions

I loaded in the palmerpenguins dataset and first displayed the data frame as as a tabke. Afterwards I grouped the mean body mass by sex, which showed that the male penguins have a higher mean body mass. The last graph shows the scatter plot of bill length and body mass. The graph shows a positive trend between bill length and body mass.
